TENTATIVE SCHOOL CALENDAR 1979-80 Subject to revision by the Board School Opens — Wednesday, September 5, 1979 Teachers report at 8:30 A.M. Pupils report at 10:00 A.M. School Closes — Wednesday, June 25, 1980 (CLOSING FOR SNOW OR OTHER EMERGENCY WILL BE MADE UP DURING THE SPRING EASTER.RECESS) SEPTEMBER FERRUARY
